import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import pandas as pd

# Load the data from the CSV file
sleep_health = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Create a categorical plot of Sleep Disorder vs Quality of Sleep
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.catplot(x='Sleep Disorder', y='Quality of Sleep', data=sleep_health, kind='bar', 
            order=sleep_health['Sleep Disorder'].unique().tolist(), palette='viridis')
plt.title('Sleep Disorder vs Quality of Sleep')
plt.xlabel('Sleep Disorder')
plt.ylabel('Quality of Sleep')
plt.legend(title='Sleep Disorder')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
